```dafny
method split_words(txt: string) returns (result: seq<string>)
    requires txt != null
    ensures (txt.Contains(" ") ==> result == txt.Split(' '))
    ensures (not txt.Contains(" ") && txt.Contains(",") ==> result == txt.Split(','))
    ensures (not txt.Contains(" ") && not txt.Contains(",") ==> result == CountOddLowerCaseLetters(txt))
    
method CountOddLowerCaseLetters(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == |{c | c in txt | IsLowerCaseOdd(c)}|
    
predicate IsLowerCaseOdd(c: char) 
    reads c
    ensures c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' 
    ensures (ord(c) % 2 == 1)
```

def check(candidate):

    assert candidate("Hello world!") == ["Hello","world!"]
    assert candidate("Hello,world!") == ["Hello","world!"]
    assert candidate("Hello world,!") == ["Hello","world,!"]
    assert candidate("Hello,Hello,world !") == ["Hello,Hello,world","!"]

    assert candidate("aaabb") == 2
    assert candidate("aaaBb") == 1
